summary.grade_trigger: Automatic F — confirmed red-team breach of multiple critical objectives (RED-001, RED-002, RED-004, RED-008, RED-009)

findings.title: No Authentication on Any API Endpoint
findings.remediation: Add JWT Bearer or API-key authentication middleware before all /api/* route mounts in app.ts. Return 401 on missing/invalid credentials. Add HMAC validation for intake webhook endpoints separately.

findings.title: No Authorization / Role-Based Access Control on Any Endpoint
findings.remediation: Implement RBAC middleware with roles (reviewer, dispatcher, admin). Apply role checks to sensitive endpoints. Return 403 on privilege violation and emit permission_denied audit events.

findings.title: State Machine Bypass via Unauthenticated overrideRoute Parameter
findings.remediation: Remove the overrideRoute bypass parameter or restrict it to admin role with full audit logging. Enforce state-machine transitions using an allowlist of valid source→target pairs per role.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Permanent Deletion of Any Work Item
findings.remediation: Gate all DELETE endpoints behind authentication (F-001) and an admin/owner role check (F-002). Log a data_deletion audit event on every successful delete.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Development Cycle Injection
findings.remediation: Require authentication and an admin/planner role on all /api/cycles mutation endpoints. Validate referenced bug/feature-request IDs exist and belong to the actor's scope.

findings.title: Webhook Intake Endpoints Lack HMAC Signature Verification
findings.remediation: Validate X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature using HMAC-SHA256 against ZENDESK_WEBHOOK_SECRET env variable. Require a bearer API key for /automated endpoint. Return 401 on mismatch.

findings.title: Required Audit Events Missing — login_attempt, permission_denied, data_export
findings.remediation: Add event_type field to logger schema. Emit structured login_attempt, permission_denied, and state_transition audit events. Standardize all workflow state-change log lines.

findings.title: Full Store Enumeration via Unbounded ?limit Parameter
findings.remediation: Clamp limit: const limit = Math.min(parseInt(req.query.limit) || 20, 100). Apply same cap in dashboard.ts. Return 400 if requested limit exceeds the cap.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Dashboard Exposes Full System State
findings.remediation: Apply the same authentication middleware (F-001) to all /api/dashboard routes. Scope dashboard views by role.

findings.title: Vote Stuffing — Unlimited Anonymous Votes, voter_id=null
findings.remediation: Require authenticated identity for vote submission. Enforce one-vote-per-authenticated-identity server-side. Reject voter_id=null with 400 Bad Request.

findings.title: Stored XSS — Script Payloads Persisted Verbatim
findings.remediation: Sanitize all text inputs server-side on ingest using DOMPurify or reject HTML-containing inputs. Set strict Content-Security-Policy header as a second layer of defence.

findings.title: No HTTP Security Headers or CORS Policy
findings.remediation: npm install helmet cors. Add app.use(helmet()) and app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(',') })) at the top of the middleware chain.

findings.title: Prometheus /metrics Endpoint Unauthenticated
findings.remediation: Add bearer token check (METRICS_TOKEN env var) or restrict to internal network range/port.

findings.title: Internal Error Messages Returned to Clients
findings.remediation: In all catch blocks, log full message server-side and return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' }).

findings.title: Intake Routes Accept Unvalidated type / priority Values
findings.remediation: Apply same enum guard used in workItems.ts:29-40 to both intake routes.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
findings.remediation: npm install express-rate-limit. Apply global limiter (100 req/15 min per IP). Apply stricter limit on intake routes (20 req/min).

findings.title: Computational DoS via Unbounded blockedBy Array in PATCH
findings.remediation: Validate and cap blockedBy array length (max 50). Return 400 Bad Request if exceeded.

findings.title: NeedsClarification Assessment Verdict Silently Mapped to Rejected
findings.remediation: Handle NeedsClarification as a distinct PendingClarification state. Return clear response indicating the specific status.

findings.title: Soft-Deleted Item IDs Enumerable via 404 Oracle
findings.remediation: Purge soft-deleted item IDs from all blockedBy arrays on deletion. Return consistent 404 for all missing items.

findings.title: No TLS Enforcement at Application Layer
findings.remediation: Add HTTPS redirect middleware for production. Add helmet.hsts(). Document TLS-terminating reverse proxy requirement.

findings.title: No GDPR Hard Delete (Right to Erasure)
findings.remediation: Implement hardDelete(id) store function. Expose behind privileged DELETE /:id?purge=true (admin only). Log data_deletion audit event.

findings.title: Missing /api/search Endpoint — Future ReDoS Risk
findings.remediation: When implementing search, use fixed-string or safe bounded regex. Rate-limit the search endpoint.
